## BIXBO stabilization audit

This branch is used for the full code, UI/UX, mobile/iOS, CI, security and release-readiness audit requested on 2026-08-15.

Validation target:
- architecture/source-size guard
- UI emoji audit
- TypeScript and ESLint
- unit/regression suite
- production build and SSR smoke
- browser E2E on desktop and mobile
- Supabase RLS/security advisor review
- iOS text editing and chart touch regression coverage
